Planner: This evening, our senior planner needs help keeping the Companion Animal Travel Desk aligned with Aurelia Skyways service notes.
Coordinator: The desk should confirm that passengers receive clear guidance before departure and that carrier checks are logged in plain language.
Handler: The ground team will move each carrier carefully between services and keep the chain of custody steady.
Trainer: <<FACT F031>> Please remind staff to keep the tone warm, professional, and calm.
Dispatcher: If a traveler asks for help, the reply should stay brief, respectful, and focused on safe transfer steps.
Planner: We should note any special care requests directly in the record and avoid adding extra remarks.
Coordinator: Peanut can be listed with the pet details if needed, and the traveler should get the same careful attention as everyone else.
Handler: The handoff from check in to cabin loading must be described clearly so the next shift can follow it without confusion.
Trainer: Staff should verify the carrier latch, confirm the label, and watch for comfort concerns during transfer.
Dispatcher: Keep the language neutral, keep the record tidy, and make sure each note supports a shared responsibility.
Planner: The Companion Animal Travel Desk will continue to guide passengers with steady, courteous service.
